name: DEM TANKS
detailed_description:
ABSOLUTE DESTRUCTION!

Shred and grind your friends (and friendships…!) into pieces in this heavy destructible top-down physics-based arena shooter! Pick up one of many available quick-swap turrets and enjoy your anihilation of enemies on the destroyable battlefield. Roam around in your hover tank, dash around obstacles, jump above enemy rockets (what?) and finally - destroy DEM TANKS!

Armory system

Tanks have their own armor system, that greatly reduces receiving damage from the front, and slightly from the sides, so plan your attack accordingly! You can always prepare yourself by locking tank rotation and face the upcoming damage without a scratch!

Destructible environment

Destroying tanks to pieces is not enough? Try destroying that wall over there! Suprise your enemies by dashing through concrete barriers and finish them with explosive shot! Find new way around dynamic battlefield, by destroying world to pieces

Movement mechanic

Armor is heavy! So tanks should not be so mobile… Well - not in this game! You can reach other side of the map in no time by Jump and dash combo - timed perfectly can help you increase your speed, and build momentum! Don’t forget - you can easily dash into enemy to make some physical damage!

Turrets projectiles and abilities

If just aiming and firing rocket would be enough, we wouldn’t be here. Each turret has its own ability that will open your mind on ways of defeating your enemies. Rocket just missed the target? Simply activate it to explode earlier! Enemy too far for grenade launcher? Just insta boost grenade speed! Shotgun cant reach the target? Simply push enemy toward you!
